silhouette.reason: Pointed ears, long muzzle, black stockings and a white-tipped brush read as a red fox. In hero.png the body is deep and the legs long, so it reads closer to a coyote; the brush looks short from the 3/4.
fixes: make the brush fuller (larger radius) so it reads as a fox tail from every view
shorten the legs ~8% and slim the chest

proportions.reason: 1.1 × 0.2 × 0.5 m holds the sourced head-body, tail and shoulder height, but the trunk is deep, the ears smallish and the hind thighs pale like the belly.
fixes: colour the hind thighs red; the cream belly zone climbs too high

materials.reason: Orange coat, cream belly and black stockings separate; the coat reads as painted vertex colour with sparse fur strands sticking out rather than a dense coat.
fixes: denser, shorter fur cards on the body so stray strands stop reading as hairs on a smooth skin

detail.reason: Eyes, nose, toes, ruff and brush tip; face planes soft, no whiskers.

wear.reason: Clean: no mud, no wet fur, no snow on the coat.
fixes: mud on the paws and snow dusting on the back (grime with the ground mask)

lod.reason: LOD2 (2.7k) keeps the outline but the legs become beige tubes with black only at the feet, so the stocking colour block shifts at distance.
fixes: paint the LOD2 legs black from the elbow down to match LOD0

technical.reason: QA PASS; 152.1k / 27.3k / 2.7k triangles; 2 draws. LOD0 is heavy for a 6 kg animal.
fixes: cap LOD0 near 80k by coarsening the fur-card density
